layout_notes: Place close to the USB connector or board entry point.
Keep D+/D- or other protected data traces from creating long stubs.
Provide a short, low-inductance return path to the intended ground or chassis strategy.
power_notes: Verify reverse working voltage for the protected line.
Do not use for VBUS surge protection unless the exact part is rated for the power path.
communication_notes: Verify line capacitance and insertion-loss suitability for the exact USB speed and CC/SBU/data use.
USB 2.0, USB 3.x, CC, SBU, and VBUS protection are not interchangeable.
common_mistakes: Using a high-capacitance ESD part on high-speed USB data lines.
Assuming package pinout from another ESD array.
Placing protection far from the connector.
ai_warnings: Generic ESD array records are not approved footprints.
Do not claim USB compliance or ESD compliance from this placeholder.

Design review reminder near external connectors.
not_suitable_use_cases: High-speed USB design without capacitance and layout verification.
Power-input surge protection without power TVS selection.

notes: Select an exact manufacturer part and verify capacitance, clamp behavior, package, and pinout before use.
